title: Pork chop, artichoke and apple bake

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a whole food or a plain cupboard staple such as crème fraîche and Dijon mustard.

supermarket.reason: Pork chops, apples, kale, crème fraîche and seasonal Jerusalem artichokes are all sold at mainstream supermarkets at everyday prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, a board and one roasting tray, and the technique is simple tray roasting.

works.reason: The artichokes get 50 minutes and the chops 30 minutes at 200°C, which will cook both through, and the quantities suit four.

honest_times.reason: The 50-minute cook time makes this a 65-minute dinner, well past the quick pace asked for.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming pork and apple tray bake suits 20 December, and the roasted artichokes are central to the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are brief, clear British home-cook instructions with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Pork chops with artichokes, kale, onions and apple make a balanced, satisfying family dinner.
